title: Selling a Move into a Higher Cabin on an Air Ticket Fare Brands Booking
content:
A move into a higher cabin is sold to the travellers on an Air Ticket Fare Brands booking as an extra rather than as a change of fare brand. This is the entry point for collecting the co-payment.

## 1. The situation this governs

The situation is a booking held in one of the Air Ticket Fare Brands whose travellers wish to move into a higher cabin. The result governed is the co-payment collected for the move, and the effect the traveller sees is an upgrade line standing on the booking with the net paid total raised by the same sum. The cabin the booking is held in is left as it stands, because the move is sold as an extra.

## 2. The write that records it

The sale is made by the desk. The agent-side tool `charge_cabin_upgrade_d9ccb8ec` is unlocked and then called; one call posts a single optional-extra line for the stated co-payment to that booking's ledger, marks it as the seating line the move is sold under, dates it on today's business date and raises the booking's net paid total by the same sum.

## 3. Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| air_booking_id | the internal reference number of the air booking the move is sold on, read from the traveller's booking record returned by the booking lookup | an identifier |
| customer_id | the traveller reference number the upgrade line is recorded against, read from the traveller profile returned by the profile lookup | an identifier |
| upgrade_copay_usd | the co-payment collected for the move | USD with exactly 2 decimal places, a positive number, rounded to the nearest cent at the moment it is passed; no empty value and no other currency |

## 4. What comes back

A plain-language confirmation line naming the reference of the upgrade line that was posted, the co-payment collected in USD to two decimal places, and the booking's net paid total once the line landed. The presence of that line reference is what indicates the move was sold; nothing is returned when no line is posted.
